latest.raw: https://huggingface.co/spaces/kipasyangin5/mva-syndrome-exploreraaaa Its data/ folder contains detailed tables — candidate_genes_variants.json, clinical_phenotype.json, karyotype_instability_matrix.json, wgs_sequencing_metrics.json, and others — that, based on their names and sizes, appear to reconstruct a substantial part of the patient's genomic and phenotypic profile rather than summarizing derived hypotheses.
